about: Coverage and test baseline for the test-pruning campaign. Temporary: the campaign folder is stripped before any PR. All paths are repo-relative.

environment.browser: the image's Playwright Chromium 141, run through a wrapper that adds --no-sandbox (Chromium refuses to start as root without it), named by LEGLAS_BROWSER

command: pnpm test:coverage (pnpm build && vitest run --passWithNoTests --coverage), with LEGLAS_BROWSER set

coverage.baselineRun: run 2 of 5; 3 of 5 runs gave exactly these totals

stability.note: Every unstable counter is a timing race: a double-close guard (proxy.ts), a health probe resolving after shutdown (server.ts), a rejected Browser.close, and the orphan-profile reaper, which takes its real path only when another Leglas Chrome profile is in the temp dir at that moment (browser.ts). Per-test pass/fail was identical in all runs.

browserDependence.note: Without a browser the real-browser describe blocks skip instead of failing. A run with more than 2 skipped cases is not comparable to this baseline.

tests.unhandledErrorsNote: listen EAFNOSUPPORT ::1, raised during the two IPv6 tests in proxy.test.ts and server.test.ts

baselineFailures.test: proxy reaches a target that is an IPv6 literal
baselineFailures.reason: environment: the VM kernel has no IPv6, so listening on ::1 fails with EAFNOSUPPORT and the test times out at 20s

baselineFailures.test: startServer reports the dev server as reachable when it is up on ::1
baselineFailures.reason: environment: no IPv6 in the VM kernel; the ::1 origin cannot listen and the test times out at 30s

baselineFailures.test: startAppProcess finds a dev server listening on IPv6 only, and reports a URL that reaches it
baselineFailures.reason: environment: no IPv6 in the VM kernel; the IPv6-only fixture dev server exits 1

baselineFailures.test: a generation's lifecycle a layout fix that strays is undone only when every file it touched can be put back
baselineFailures.reason: environment: runs as root, and chmod 0o444 does not stop root writing the file back, so the locked row reads ready; passes with CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE dropped, fails without

skipped.test: the real agent CLIs named in LEGLAS_LIVE_AGENTS read as signed in
skipped.reason: needs LEGLAS_LIVE_AGENTS and signed-in agent CLIs; CI skips it too

skipped.test: the real agent CLIs named in LEGLAS_LIVE_AGENTS read as signed out with no saved login
skipped.reason: needs LEGLAS_LIVE_AGENTS and signed-in agent CLIs; CI skips it too

laneAttribution.method: each lane's test files run alone with coverage; a statement counts for a lane when that lane's run executes it
laneAttribution.hitOnlyInLaneRunsNote: the orphan-profile reaper race in browser.ts, listed under stability.unstableCounters
laneAttribution.statementsByExactLaneSetNote: A statement under L1+L2 is hit by those two lanes and no other. If both prune the tests that reach it, neither lane alone sees the loss; only a run of the merged lanes does.

coverageBlind.test: leglas watch --json, as a process > stdout is JSON lines while the agent's output goes to stderr
coverageBlind.why: starts the built cli bin (dist/bin.js) in a child process

coverageBlind.test: what the tools tell a host about themselves > the published server's instructions name every tool it lists, and fit what a host keeps
coverageBlind.why: starts the built mcp bin (dist/bin.js) over stdio in a child process

coverageBlind.test: prints %s from any working directory (2 rows) and a missing version exits with the specified sentence
coverageBlind.why: runs site/release-notes.ts as a script in a child node; the in-process tests in the same file still cover its exported functions

coverageBlind.test: every mcp test that reaches cli or server code
coverageBlind.why: mcp imports the cli through the package export, which is the built bundle with the server inlined and no source map; cli and server code reached this way counts nowhere

coverageBlind.test: every cli test that reaches server code (run.test.ts starts a real server)
coverageBlind.why: cli imports @leglas/server through its export, the built dist with no source map; server code reached this way counts nowhere

notBlind: Server tests that spawn node (agents/runner, generation, branches/worktree, capture) start fixture scripts, git or Chrome; the production code that drives them runs in-process and is measured.
